label: NRD denoiser
hint: REBLUR diffuse SH and PBR denoising. Ray Reconstruction replaces NRD; the saved choice resumes without RR.

label: Denoise local lighting
hint: Denoise authored and emissive lighting with REBLUR.

label: PBR firefly filter (REBLUR)
hint: Extra local-light firefly suppression for PBR materials. Requires REBLUR receiving local lighting; bypassed by RR and progressive accumulation. Ordinary NRD anti-firefly processing is already enabled.

label: SIGMA sun shadows
hint: Denoise distant-light shadows. Ray Reconstruction replaces this filter.

label: Blue noise sun shadows
hint: Use blue noise with filtered sun shadows; bypassed by RR.

label: Native resolution TAA
hint: Temporal antialiasing at native resolution. Bypassed when FSR/DLSS reconstruct the image or progressive accumulation is enabled.

label: Local direct clamp
hint: Maximum linear luminance per primary local-light sample. 0 disables. Lower values can remove real highlights and bypass PBR lighting reuse.

label: Indirect clamp
hint: Maximum linear luminance per indirect path. 0 disables. Lower values can remove real highlights and bypass water/PBR lighting reuse.

label: Primary visibility
hint: Raster G-buffer or ray queries for primary surfaces. Both modes use path-traced lighting.

label: Samples per pixel
hint: More path samples reduce noise and increase render time.

label: Maximum indirect bounces
hint: Maximum traced indirect surface interactions. SHARC can supply a longer cached lighting tail.

label: Adaptive indirect termination
hint: Probabilistically stop low-contribution paths. May reduce work and increase noise.

label: Bounces before termination
hint: Minimum indirect bounces before adaptive termination. Must be below the maximum to have an effect.

label: Reuse water indirect samples
hint: Share diffuse water lighting with compatible temporal modes. Bypassed by RR, raw reference rendering and indirect clamping.

label: PBR lighting reuse (experimental)
hint: Reuse local lighting on similar rough surfaces. Bypassed by RR and luminance clamps; may change lighting and temporal noise.

label: Iridescence
hint: Thin-film interference colours on materials that have a film (soap bubbles, oil slicks, beetle shells). Off: those materials reflect without it.

label: Caustics
hint: Light through water and bumpy glass is focused by their normal maps' waves and bumps into caustics on what it lights.

label: Caustics strength
hint: How strongly the surface bends the light (0.4: as water and glass do). Used with Caustics on.

label: Caustics focus depth (m)
hint: Caustics fade in over this depth behind the surface: shallow water and thin glass have none, as light has not yet been focused. 0: at once. Used with Caustics on.

label: Caustics contrast
hint: Exaggerates the caustics: past 1, brighter lines and darker gaps (not physical; for surfaces whose waves barely focus the light). Used with Caustics on.

label: Progressive reference rendering
hint: Accumulate samples while the camera is still. Bypasses denoising, reconstruction, TAA and SHARC; movement resets accumulation.

label: Local lighting
hint: Evaluate authored local lights and emissive lighting.

label: Authored local lights
hint: Evaluate sphere, spot and area lights authored in the scene.

label: Emissive lighting
hint: Cast light from emissive geometry. Visible emissive textures remain visible when disabled.

label: Local light samples
hint: Minimum direct local-light sample count.

label: Emissive candidates
hint: Compare unshadowed emissive candidates while retaining one shadow ray per local-light sample.

label: Adaptive local-light sampling
hint: Raise the sample budget near important light clusters; configured counts remain minimums.

label: Blue noise local lights
hint: Blue noise for primary local-light samples with NRD local denoising. Bypassed by RR.

label: Guide by recent visibility
hint: Guide light sampling using recent visibility while retaining exploration.

label: Nearby emissive sampling (experimental)
hint: Sample nearby area lights with the same shadow-ray count; adds GPU work.

label: Authored / emissive sampling
hint: Separate lighting families can use separate denoiser histories. Per-family mode may double shadow rays. RR combines shared budgets.

label: Sky illumination
hint: Include sky illumination in lighting.

label: SHARC radiance cache
hint: Reuse indirect lighting on static diffuse and rough PBR surfaces. Sharp surfaces continue tracing. Progressive reference rendering bypasses SHARC.

label: Cache scene scale
hint: World-space cache grid scale in renderer scene units.

label: Update downscale
hint: One update path per downscale tile. Lower values update more densely at higher GPU cost.

label: Cache capacity (power of 2)
hint: Number of cache entries is 2 raised to this value. Larger caches require more GPU memory.

label: Cache accumulation frames
hint: Maximum cache history length. Longer history smooths noise but responds more slowly.

label: Expire entries after frames
hint: Retire cache entries that have not been updated for this many frames.

label: FSR sharpening
hint: Sharpening strength, used only by FSR 3.1.
